instruction: Independently identify an informative, legal next challenge from this frozen world and the evidence above. State your own test hypothesis in the task request; do not invent facts or supply answers. Choose optional information requirements deliberately, not by copying every fact key. If your goal depends on registered external events, select their actual IDs in external_schedule. A precise refusal challenge is also legitimate when a business boundary prevents fulfillment.

proposal_contract.confirmations: confirmation_requirements contains exact native operation objects, never prose descriptions. Omit it unless a concrete operation can be specified from frozen facts.
proposal_contract.events: external_schedule may contain only registered event IDs for the selected business objects. The Designer cannot create events or provide a reference witness.
proposal_contract.frames: Do not submit frames or selector fields; the compiler derives the union of native scopes for your selected profiles.
proposal_contract.goals: Each completion goal must reference an entity already present in the frozen world, its actual collection and an existing field. A future case/refund/quote cannot be a goal entity when it does not yet exist. Choose desired field values from the native business model; the compiler independently proves reachability.
proposal_contract.information: Use only fact_keys actually present in each selected profile's private_facts. An information requirement is a requirement for Customer disclosure, not permission to invent a fact.
